films.title: Let Yourself Go
films.overview: Depressed Jewish shrink Elia one day meets Claudia, a young and eccentric personal trainer.

films.title: Santocielo
films.overview: In paradise, a group gathers to discuss why people still act selfishly, even though Jesus sacrificed himself for them 2,000 years ago. As a result, a new Messiah is sent to Earth to address the issue.

films.title: 18 Presents
films.overview: Elisa is only forty when an incurable disease takes her from her husband and their daughter. Before her heart stops, Elisa finds a way to stay close to her: a gift for every birthday up to her adult age, 18 gifts to try to accompany her child's growth year after year.
